subject.title: fix(browser): keep tab reachability retry delay abortable

question: Is the existing helper/route timing evidence sufficient for this three-line browser cancellation fix, or must the contributor demonstrate cancellation through an actual managed-browser tab mutation route?
rationale: The patch is mechanically sound and follows an established helper pattern, but repository policy treats after-fix real behavior proof as an external-PR merge gate; only a maintainer can authorize a proportional override.

options.title: Require route-level proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, or a short recording showing a real managed-browser tab mutation aborting during the reachability delay with no subsequent mutation.

options.title: Approve a proof override
options.body: Accept the existing timing evidence because the changed code path is narrow, the shared helper contract is established, and existing tests cover the no-post-abort-mutation invariant.

recommendation.title: Require route-level proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, or a short recording showing a real managed-browser tab mutation aborting during the reachability delay with no subsequent mutation.

likelyOwner.reason: The browser plugin ownership history and the contributor’s explicit request make this the best available decision owner.
